title: Algophony Generation Record
description: Schema for a generated soundscape metadata record.

audio_id.description: Unique audio identifier including prompt, provider, and variant.

prompt_id.description: Reference to the prompt that generated this audio.

model.description: Name of the generation model or system.

model_version.description: Version identifier for the model, if known.

generation_date.description: ISO 8601 date when the audio was generated.

duration.description: Actual duration of the generated audio in seconds.

seed.description: Random seed used for generation, if applicable.

license_status.description: Explicit license or usage status for this generated audio.

storage_uri.description: Relative path or URI to the audio file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the audio file. Required when the file exists.

akouo_report_id.description: Reference to the AKOÚŌ listening report for this generation.
